app.catalog.markdown.eixo_interpretativo: **Eixo interpretativo** A plataforma observa a circulação audiovisual como um fenômeno territorial, cultural e técnico. O problema não é apenas localizar vídeos, mas compreender quem hospeda, quem indexa, quem descreve, em qual idioma, sob qual regime de acesso, por qual plataforma e em que escala territorial esse audiovisual se torna público. **O que a plataforma afirma com maior segurança** - quando há evidência pública detectável de audiovisual; - quando há apenas evidência pública indireta; - quando não foi encontrada evidência pública detectável de audiovisual; - quando o site não pôde ser verificado. **O que a plataforma evita afirmar** - que a ausência de evidência pública detectável equivale à inexistência de acervo audiovisual; - que a visibilidade pública esgota a complexidade do acervo; - que uma única coleta resolve o problema da descrição e do acesso audiovisual.
app.catalog.markdown.esta_categoria_re_n: This category only includes units classified as **{value_0}**. The observatory allows you to work with all of them together, but always preserving the same analytical level: **{value_1}**.
app.catalog.markdown.este_cat_logo_organ: This catalog organizes the curatorial selection of videos based on basic metadata and a thematic classification based on title, subject and description, excluding platform noise or external incorporation by default.
app.catalog.markdown.este_observat_rio_i: This observatory investigates the public visibility of audiovisual in archival environments on the web. At this stage, the unit analyzed is the **Archives Portal Europe (APE)**, treated as a general archival portal, and not as a specialized audiovisual repository. **Objective** To examine how audiovisual becomes publicly visible, discoverable and accessible on institutional websites linked to the APE, considering both the explicit presence and more indirect forms of evidence. **Methodological principle** The absence of detected video does not authorize the assertion, in itself, of the absence of an audiovisual collection. In the context of a general portal, non-detection may indicate at least four situations: - the audiovisual collection may not exist; - the collection may exist, but not be digitized; - the collection may be digitized, but not public; - the collection may be public, but barely visible or undetectable with the current collection strategy. In this observatory, general sources such as the APE can remain mapped even when part of their institutions return zero audiovisual, because this zero is also analytically informative for the study of the public visibility of the collection.
app.catalog.markdown.este_recorte_toma_o: This cut takes the **{value_0}** as a specialized audiovisual unit. Unlike the APE, which functions as a general archive portal, here the audiovisual tends to occupy a central institutional position. **Objective** To examine how an explicitly audiovisual archive organizes the public presence of its videos, collections, descriptions and digital mediations. **Methodological principle** In this section, the central issue is no longer just the existence of detectable public evidence, but the way in which a specialized archive presents, contextualizes and distributes its audiovisual content on the institutional web.

The absence of detectable public evidence is not treated as proof of the non-existence of a collection.

overview.ui.caption.esta_auditoria_imped: This audit prevents the European closure from being read as absolute exhaustiveness. It documents units covered by active bases, legacy sources, radars and future candidates, keeping the continental MVP open to controlled expansion.
overview.ui.caption.esta_auditoria_separ: This audit separates paid private banks, commercial licensing catalogs, and paid/authenticated streaming. Not all commercial access remains outside the active base: when there are public records evaluated at the observatory, it remains its own analytical modality.
overview.ui.caption.esta_camada_nao_inco: Esta camada não incorpora novas unidades automaticamente. Ela observa a superfície pública de Archives Hub, FranceArchives, PARES e Portal Português de Arquivos para decidir, com evidência registrada, qual fonte pode seguir para validação total e qual exige nova rota de acesso.
overview.ui.caption.esta_matriz_separa_d: This matrix separates methodological decision from technical availability: a source can be relevant to the European closure and yet remain outside active units until a stable access route exists.
overview.ui.caption.estas_rotas_nao_prom: Estas rotas não promovem automaticamente uma fonte a unidade ativa. Elas registram caminhos oficiais ou documentados que podem ser testados antes da incorporação.
overview.ui.caption.este_modulo_separa_o: This module separates the full European registry from the operational backlog queue. It identifies European audiovisual aggregators, networks, directories and archives without a guess: aggregators first, specialized directories second, individual files by controlled expansion. Scanning official sources include Europeana, FIAF, EFG, EUscreen, FIAT/IFTA, INEDITS, ACE and EBU. Presence in the registry does not mean automatic incorporation; presence in the queue means pending analysis.
overview.ui.caption.este_quadro_explicit: This table explains the methodological state of the Europe stage. He does not claim that all European audiovisual archives have been identified; records what already operates as an active unit, what is registered and what remains in an auditable queue for expansion.
overview.ui.caption.este_quadro_preserva: This table preserves the performance of each documentary unit in each round of the observatory.
overview.ui.caption.este_quadro_testa_si: This framework tests minimal signs of technical feasibility for FranceArchives without fully transferring the XML package and without transforming the source into an active unit.
overview.ui.caption.este_quadro_testa_sr: This framework tests SRU and OAI-PMH in minimal mode, without promoting Archives Hub to the active drive while the access route is not stable.
overview.ui.caption.estes_arquivos_prese: These files preserve the global traceability of the observatory, allowing rounds, active units and historical results to be audited.
overview.ui.caption.estes_quadros_mostra: These tables show how the units differ not only in volume, but also in the way the audiovisual becomes publicly accessible.
